title: The Way of Product: Caden Damiano on Eric's wake-vs-party opener
summary: Software designer and 'The Way of Product' podcast host Caden Damiano publishes a 2,100-word LinkedIn Pulse interview profile of Eric and Incorruptible, opening with the founder-at-a-wake story that anchors the book.
blockquote: You're not hearing me, man. This isn't a party. It's a wake. He doesn't work there anymore.
blockquote_source: Eric Ries, quoted by Caden Damiano
attribution_title: Software designer; host of The Way of Product podcast
